usageNotes: Use this endpoint to tail or page through the Ceph log on a specific PVE node — useful for diagnosing OSD failures, HEALTH_WARN/HEALTH_ERR transitions, or slow I/O events. The caller must hold the Sys.Syslog privilege on /nodes/{node}; API tokens are supported. Paginate with start and limit together to walk large logs without truncation, since omitting limit typically caps output at ~50 lines.

examples.summary: Fetch the most recent 100 Ceph log lines from node pve1

tips: Each returned object has 'n' (1-based line number) and 't' (text); use 'n' to track position when paginating with subsequent start offsets.
This reads the Ceph log from the perspective of the queried node — log content may differ between nodes if Ceph is in a degraded or split-brain state.
Combine with get_nodes_node_ceph_status to correlate log events with current cluster health.
